evidence: Anterior cruciate ligament (ACL): There is mucoid degeneration of the anterior cruciate ligament, which otherwise appears intact.
Medial collateral ligament (MCL): Normal.
Medial meniscus: There is a complex tear involving the posterior horn and body, with a large radial tear at the posterior root attachment. Moderate extrusion.
Lateral meniscus: There is a complex tear involving the anterior and posterior root attachments. Fraying of the inner margin diffusely. No extrusion.
Medial compartment cartilage: There is mild to moderate cartilage thinning and surface irregularity diffusely. Small osteophytes.
Lateral compartment cartilage: There is mild cartilage thinning at the posterior aspect, with cartilage fissuring centrally near the intercondylar notch.
Patellofemoral compartment cartilage: There is mild to moderate cartilage thinning and fissuring at the patella, medial greater than lateral. Trochlear cartilage appears intact.
Small joint effusion.
Mild, diffuse synovial proliferation.
Moderate Baker cyst.
